{{Quote|Senator Nalrin Daheel, representative of the wisdom and beauty of the Ugnaught people.|Senator Daheel|<ref name="TOR" />}}
'''Nalrin Daheel''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Ugnaught/Legends|Ugnaught]] [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] who represented [[Gentes/Legends|Gentes]] in the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] against the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|resurgent Sith Empire]].

==Biography==
An elderly [[Ugnaught/Legends|Ugnaught]] statesman, Nalrin Daheel represented the Ugnaught peoples' interest in the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Senate]] circa [[3643 BBY]] following the [[Great Galactic War]] and the resurgence of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|resurgent Sith Empire]]. Part of the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]-era Senate, Daheel played politics with his colleagues in an attempt to get justice for his people. While attempting to appear friendly with Senator [[Gunaray Dod]], Daheel secretly detested the [[Neimoidian/Legends|Neimoidian]], believing him to be in league with the criminal organization [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun]], but lacking any proof. Daheel hoped to trace Dod's dealings with the criminals through obtaining rare Neimoidian currency called [[Kavin bill|Kavin]] to implicate Senator Dod.<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Nalrin Daheel appears in the [[BioWare]] MMORPG ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''. Daheel gives the mission "Follow the Money", where he asks the player to recover 8 stacks of Kavin bills from Black Sun thugs so that he can prove Dod's corruption.<ref name="TOR" />
